detailed_descriptions.en: Someone stripped every single nail from your house. Your mission is simple: pick up and hammer them back in. All 10,000 of them. Grab your hammer, get to work, and make sure to upgrade your tools along the way! Gather Every Single Nail At first, you'll pick up nails one by one... but not for long. Hammer Every Single Nail Hammer nails and earn money while doing do. Some doors have a nails requirement to be opened. What secrets lie behind them? Upgrades & Abilities Spend your hard-earned cash on upgrades and abilities: • Automatic Pickup & Placement to let the game work for you. • Chain Lightning to hammer multiple nails at once. • And much more! Hammer these nails! is a short experience designed to be completed in one sitting (~2 hours).
